question: Find the display names of users from 'United Kingdom' who have earned at least one badge and own posts with a total favorite count of 5 or more. Among these users, return only those whose reputation equals the minimum reputation of this group.

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying_users AS (
    SELECT 
        u.XCL_052 AS user_id,
        u.XCL_055 AS display_name,
        u.XCL_053 AS reputation
    FROM users u
    INNER JOIN badges b ON u.XCL_052 = b.XCL_002
    INNER JOIN posts p ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033
    WHERE u.XCL_058 = 'United Kingdom'
    GROUP BY u.XCL_052, u.XCL_055, u.XCL_053
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.XCL_001) >= 1
       AND SUM(p.XCL_039) >= 5
),
min_rep AS (
    SELECT MIN(reputation) AS min_reputation
    FROM qualifying_users
)
SELECT qu.display_name
FROM qualifying_users qu
CROSS JOIN min_rep mr
WHERE qu.reputation = mr.min_reputation

WITH qualifying_users AS (

        u.XCL_052 AS user_id,

),
min_rep AS (

WHERE qu.reputation = mr.min_reputation
